notes.title: Development Update: Demo Release Postponement and Future Plans
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The Bearstone Campsite development team is excited to announce a strategic step toward delivering the best possible gaming experience. While we are planning to launch the full version in Q4 2025, we have decided to postpone our demo release to Next Fest in June 2025.

Why the Postponement?
Our primary goal in making this decision is to maximize the initial impact of the demo while ensuring that the full version meets your high expectations in terms of hardware, features, and quality. The meticulous improvements we are implementing during development are crucial to providing you with a richer and smoother experience.

Our Strategic Approach
This postponement is a carefully considered move that goes beyond short-term challenges and aligns with our long-term vision for quality and sustainable success. Our commitment to continuous improvement drives us to address every detail with the utmost care.

Thank you for your understanding and ongoing support. We will continue to keep you updated on all future developments.

Enjoy,
Holy Marmot
Bearstone Campsite Development Team
